findings.where: Screen 2 'Let go' Why and working line 'pull: 4 × 0.5 = 2 N, towards rest'; screen 1 text and its 'pull' arrow
findings.what: The mass hangs, and a 4 N/m spring holding 1 kg is still stretched about 1.95 m when the mass is lifted 0.5 m, so the spring on its own pulls up with about 7.8 N; the 2 N downward pull is the spring and the weight together. Saying 'the spring pulls with 4 × 0.5 = 2 N' is therefore false. The gravity point is only in the ignores note, so add one short sentence on screen 1, such as 'At rest its weight is balanced, so measured from rest only the extra pull counts', and call the arrow the extra or net pull.
